Method.name: GetComponentsForAll
Method.Implementation:
Set tStatus = ..GetEnvironment(.tEnvironment,.tInstanceType,.tInstanceName) $$$ThrowOnError(tStatus)
set SQLCODE = 0 Set tDir = $GET(^EAI.GetSettings("Dir"),"/itf-share/itf-tmp/") Set tFilename = "EnsembleComponents-" _ tInstanceType _ "-" _ $REPLACE($REPLACE($ZDATETIME($h, 8, 1)," ","_"),":","") _ ".TXT" Set OutFile = ##class(%File).NormalizeFilename(tFilename,tDir) Open OutFile:"WNS":10 If '$Test { $$$ThrowOnError( "Output file cannot be opened.") Quit } Use OutFile Set tRS = ##class(%ResultSet).%New("%SYS.Namespace:List") Set tSC = tRS.Execute() For { Quit:'tRS.Next() set nmSp = tRS.Get("Nsp") // Write !, nmSp _ ", " _ tRS.Get("Status") if (tRS.Get("Status") = 1) { do ##class(IHC.EAI.GetSettings.Util).GetComponentsForNamespace(nmSp) Write !, "---- " _ nmSp _ " ----" } } Do tRS.Close()
quit $$$OK
